maya: lunchtime thought experiment: if the office toaster were an LLM, which model would it be? :toast:
liam: that cranky legacy model that insists on verbose settings and occasionally chars your bread :sweat_smile:
devon: toaster = single param: CRISP_LEVEL. ask for nuance, it panics. 😂
ash: calling it 'BagelBabbler'
kelly: gpt-4o-toaster: writes a 3-paragraph apology when it burns a bagel and recommends a playlist to calm it. :crying_face:
ryan: ops-bot: "Toaster v1.3 deployed. latency=3s, throughput=2 slices/min, crumb-leak=true" :robot_face:
maya: quick emoji poll: :thumbsup: old-school reliable, :fire: drama-toaster, :clap: apologetic-llm-toaster
liam: :thumbsup:
devon: :fire:
kelly: :clap: lol
maya: prompt engineering challenge: `Produce golden-brown but avoid ignition.` always ends up with charcoal.
liam: add unit test: `assert(slice.color == \"golden\")` — flaky in prod.
ryan: feature request: toaster dashboard in kitchen with toast latency, crumb-cache hit rate, and #burns today. I'd watch that.
devon: naming idea: 'Redwood Crisp' — sounds like a startup toaster.
maya: perfect. potluck theme decided. I'll spin up a real poll in #random. :tada:
ops-bot: kitchen notice: router reboot at 15:00 — toaster may be unavailable ~2 minutes. :bell:
